name: Vantage & Rowe
tagline: Trial lawyers judged by juries, not brochures
description: A monolithic litigation-firm site in deep ink and oxblood, with a mouse-tilt stack of case files, count-up verdict figures, and Didone authority in every headline.

name: Axiom Atelier
tagline: Mass, light, reason — architecture from Chicago
description: A blueprint-meets-gallery studio site whose hero is a CSS-built massing model that assembles itself and turns on a slow turntable above a cyan survey grid.

name: Northgate Smile Studio
tagline: Dentistry that feels like a deep breath
description: A porcelain-and-seafoam clinic site where glass appointment panels float on mouse parallax over a clean-air particle field, and every price is on the wall.
